title: anneslia cumingii
intro: Anneslia cumingii, commonly known as the "Lobelia", is a plant species belonging to the Campanulaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Anneslia cumingii include anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic effects, which help in relieving muscle cramps and spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
